page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by dedicated AMD EPYC processors running at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory allocated per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated hardware accelerators or graphics processing units on this instance type.

The ecs.u2a-c1m4.8xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources and a standard memory footprint without the overhead of local NVMe storage or specialized GPU hardware. The balanced resource allocation makes it suitable for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and moderate database workloads that rely on network-attached storage.
